ERP Finance Specialist

Apply

Job Description:

We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical ERP Finance Specialist with 3 to 4 years of experience to bridge the gap between our finance operations and our technology infrastructure. In this role, you will be the go-to person for maintaining, optimizing, and supporting our ERP finance modules (e.g., SAP, Oracle NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics 365, or Workday).

You will work closely with the accounting and finance teams to streamline financial workflows, ensure data integrity, troubleshoot system issues, and lead minor enhancement projects.

Key Responsibilities:

  • System Maintenance & Support: Serve as the primary point of contact for day-to-day ERP finance module issues.
  • Process Optimization: Analyze existing financial workflows and implement system configurations or automation to improve efficiency and accuracy.

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • Experience: 3-4 years of hands-on experience supporting or implementing ERP financial modules.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Management Information Systems (MIS), or a related field.
  • Technical Proficiency: Strong configuration skills in at least one major ERP system.
